properties.name: maple.framework.feign.logger-level.enabled
properties.description: Register the framework default Feign logger level (BASIC).

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.error-decoder.enabled
properties.description: Register the framework Feign error decoder. Disabled by default; enable it explicitly to map remote statuses to business exceptions.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.request-interceptor.enabled
properties.description: Register the framework Feign request interceptor that propagates auth token, platform and trace id.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.auth-token-aspect.enabled
properties.description: Register the aspect that validates inbound Feign auth tokens for annotated methods.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.auth-token.enabled
properties.description: Generate and inject the Feign auth token. When false, token generation is skipped and a warning is logged.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.fallback-config.enabled
properties.description: Register the default Feign fallback specification.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.circuit-breaker.enabled
properties.description: Register the framework retry circuit breaker customizer.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.circuit-breaker.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries performed by the framework retry circuit breaker. 0 disables retries; client side business errors are never retried.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.circuit-breaker.backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied to the backoff delay between retries.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.circuit-breaker.open-timeout
properties.description: How long the circuit stays open before transitioning to half-open.

properties.name: maple.framework.feign.circuit-breaker.reset-timeout
properties.description: How long to wait after a failure before resetting the circuit breaker state.
